Mark it down 🚨 Build Your Own Carabiner Night is coming to Azucar and it's giving craft-table meets cocktail hour. Beads, charms, a little Christmas sparkle, and Jayme hosting the whole glittery affair 🎄✨ Grab a drink, pick your charms, and build something that's 100% you — snowmen, little gift boxes, hearts, snowflakes, all of it fair game. This is the kind of night that sneaks up on you as a favorite, so don't sleep on it. Tickets are $10 and all proceeds go toward upcoming sapphic events, so you're crafting for a cause while you're at it 💕 Save the date, bring a friend, and let's get bedazzling.

🗓️ Sunday, December 6 • 7PM–10PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 $10 Tickets
#AzucarPasco #OutAndAbout #CarabinerNight #CraftNight #PascoWA #TriCities #LatinxCommunity #HolidayVibes

Picture it 🎄 Soft holiday lights, a table full of beads and little silver charms, a cocktail sweating in your hand, and Jayme keeping the whole room laughing while everyone bedazzles their own carabiner 🧷✨ There's something about a craft night that just hits different at Azucar — the clink of beads, the slow build of a chain coming together, the little gasp when your piece finally looks cute. Snowmen dangling next to candy canes, hearts tangled up with snowflakes, every creation a little different because every person at that table is. It's cozy, it's sparkly, it's the kind of Sunday that feels like a warm hug before the week starts. Come build something to clip onto your bag and carry the vibe with you all season long 💕

🗓️ Sunday, December 6 • 7PM–10PM

Come as you are, leave with something only you could've made 🫶 Build Your Own Carabiner Night at Azucar is for everybody — first-timers who've never beaded a thing in their life, regulars who already have a whole collection, friends looking for a low-key Sunday hang. Jayme's hosting with a cocktail in hand and good energy to match, and the table's stacked with charms and sparkle ready for whatever you're feeling. No pressure, no perfect project required — just good company, a little Christmas magic, and a room that welcomes you exactly as you show up. Plus every ticket helps fund upcoming sapphic events, so you're building community right along with your carabiner 💕 Bring a friend, bring yourself, bring your messiest craft energy — there's a seat at this table for you.

Here's everything you need to know 📋 Azucar's Lounge is hosting Build Your Own Carabiner Night — beads, charms, and Christmas sparkle galore, with Jayme hosting and a cocktail definitely involved. Grab your $10 ticket, show up, and build your own carabiner or bracelet from scratch. All proceeds go toward upcoming sapphic events, so your craft project is doing double duty. Doors open at 7PM and the beading goes till 10PM — plenty of time to perfect your masterpiece and sip something good while you do it 🍸✨ Easy night, cute payoff, great cause. Don't miss it.
